probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Lyngvær Menu Lyngvær Close Overview Buy Author Rooms Offers Restaurant Surroundings Events The house Plan your stay Booking Practical info Gift vouchers Contact Get in touch [email protected] +00 00 00 00 00 On the island now Contact We answer every message within a day, faster when the boat is not running. Write, call or come by boat [email protected] Write +00 00 00 00 00 Call the house Lyngvær, 8850 Herøy, Norway Address Every route ends at the quay Sandnessjøen is the last town on the mainland. Our boat leaves the guest quay at 11:00 and 15:30 every day. From Oslo About 4 hours Fly to Sandnessjøen Stokka, changing in Bodø or Trondheim. We meet the afternoon flights at the quay. From Trondheim Overnight The coastal ferry north calls at Sandnessjøen every evening. Stay a night in town and take our morning boat. By car About 9 hours from Oslo Drive the E6 to Mosjøen and the coast road to Sandnessjøen. Park at the harbour; we keep two spaces for guests. Questions, groups and press To book a room, use the booking form so we can check the dates for you. Everything else lands here.
